applescript.status: CONFIRMED — Pages has AppleScript support. Blocks on template chooser dialog. Always ensure a document is open before querying.

list_open_documents.script:
tell application "Pages"
	get name of every document
end tell
list_open_documents.notes: Returns empty list if no documents open. Blocks/times out if template chooser dialog is visible.

create_new_document.script:
tell application "Pages"
	set newDoc to make new document
end tell
create_new_document.notes: Creates blank document directly without showing template chooser. Reliable.

open_document.script:
tell application "Pages"
	open POSIX file "/path/to/file.pages"
end tell
open_document.notes: Must use POSIX file with POSIX path string. Plain string paths do NOT work.

close_document.script:
tell application "Pages"
	close front document saving no
end tell
close_document.notes: saving parameter: yes / no / ask. Use 'saving no' to discard without dialog.

close_named_document.script:
tell application "Pages"
	close document "DocName" saving no
end tell

get_document_name.script:
tell application "Pages"
	get name of front document
end tell

get_document_modified.script:
tell application "Pages"
	get modified of front document
end tell

get_document_path.script:
tell application "Pages"
	get file of front document
end tell
get_document_path.returns: file reference (not a usable POSIX string directly)
get_document_path.notes: Returns 'file' object but POSIX path conversion fails. Workaround: check name instead, or use Finder to resolve. Only works for saved documents.

get_paragraph_text.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		get paragraph 1 of body text
	end tell
end tell
get_paragraph_text.notes: Can iterate: 'repeat with i from 1 to (count of paragraphs of body text)'

count_paragraphs.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		get count of paragraphs of body text
	end tell
end tell

count_words_workaround.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		set paraText to paragraph 1 of body text as string
		set wordCount to count of words of paraText
		return wordCount
	end tell
end tell
count_words_workaround.returns: integer — word count of first paragraph
count_words_workaround.notes: document.word_count property does NOT exist. Workaround: get paragraph text, count words via AppleScript string operations. Must iterate all paragraphs for full doc count.

type_text_via_keystroke.script:
tell application "Pages" to activate
delay 0.5
tell application "System Events"
	keystroke "Your text here"
end tell
type_text_via_keystroke.notes: Direct text setting on body text fails with -10006. Use System Events keystroke instead. Pages must be frontmost and document must have focus.

save_document.script:
-- Via keyboard shortcut (triggers Save dialog for new docs):
tell application "Pages" to activate
tell application "System Events"
	keystroke "s" using {command down}
end tell
save_document.notes: AppleScript 'save in path' times out waiting for dialog. Use Cmd+S then handle the dialog via System Events. For first save, a dialog appears requiring filename input.

save_dialog_navigation.script:
-- After triggering save dialog:
tell application "System Events"
	tell process "Pages"
		tell sheet 1 of window 1
			set value of text field 1 to "filename"
			delay 0.2
			-- Open Go To dialog to navigate to folder:
			keystroke "g" using {command down, shift down}
		end tell
	end tell
end tell
delay 0.5
-- Confirm folder path:
tell application "System Events"
	key code 36
end tell
delay 0.5
-- Click Save:
tell application "System Events"
	tell process "Pages"
		tell sheet 1 of window 1
			click button "Save"
		end tell
	end tell
end tell
save_dialog_navigation.notes: Set text field 1 = filename, use Cmd+Shift+G to invoke Go To Folder, type path, Return to confirm, then click Save.

export_pdf.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		export to POSIX file "/path/to/output.pdf" as PDF
	end tell
end tell
export_pdf.notes: MUST use 'POSIX file' keyword. Plain string path gives error 6. Works silently with no dialog.

export_word.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		export to POSIX file "/path/to/output.docx" as Microsoft Word
	end tell
end tell

export_epub.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell document 1
		export to POSIX file "/path/to/output.epub" as ePub
	end tell
end tell
export_epub.notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-03-23. Works silently with no dialog. Use 'document 1' not 'front document' if accessing by index. Must use POSIX file keyword.

export_plaintext.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell document 1
		export to POSIX file "/path/to/output.txt" as unformatted text
	end tell
end tell

export_pages09.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell document 1
		export to POSIX file "/path/to/output.pages" as Pages 09
	end tell
end tell

list_templates.script:
tell application "Pages"
	set tmplIds to id of every template
	return tmplIds
end tell
list_templates.notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-03-23. Returns IDs like 'Application/Blank/ISO', 'Application/23_Essay/ISO'. Does NOT require any document open.

read_password_protected.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		get password protected
	end tell
end tell
read_password_protected.notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-03-23. Readable but NOT settable (throws -10006). Use File > Set Password… menu to set via System Events.

get_document_template_id.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		set tmpl to document template
		return id of tmpl
	end tell
end tell
get_document_template_id.notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-03-23. Returns the template this document was based on.

track_changes_check.script:
tell application "System Events"
	tell process "Pages"
		set tcEnabled to enabled of menu item "Accept Change" of menu "Edit" of menu bar 1
		return tcEnabled
	end tell
end tell
track_changes_check.returns: boolean — true when Track Changes is active
track_changes_check.notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-03-23. When TC is on: Accept Change and Reject Change menu items are enabled, toolbar shows '<> N Changes' with Accept/Reject/Paused controls. Toggle TC with: click menu item 'Track Changes' of menu 'Edit' of menu bar 1

track_changes_toggle.script:
tell application "System Events"
	tell process "Pages"
		click menu item "Track Changes" of menu "Edit" of menu bar 1
	end tell
end tell
track_changes_toggle.notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-03-23. Toggle Track Changes on/off. When on, toolbar gains: '< > N Changes' counter, Accept, Reject, and Paused/On toggle buttons.

set_password_via_menu.script:
tell application "System Events"
	tell process "Pages"
		click menu item "Set Password…" of menu "File" of menu bar 1
	end tell
end tell
set_password_via_menu.notes: CONFIRMED accessible 2026-03-23. Enabled for saved documents. Opens dialog to set/remove password. Must handle dialog UI for actual password entry.

read_sections.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		set secCount to count of sections
		set sec1Para1 to paragraph 1 of body text of section 1 as string
		return {sections: secCount, firstPara: sec1Para1}
	end tell
end tell
read_sections.returns: record with section count and first paragraph of section 1
read_sections.notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-03-23. Sections are fully accessible. body text of section N supports paragraph iteration.

get_all_document_properties.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		get properties
	end tell
end tell
get_all_document_properties.returns: record with: current page, id, body text (full text!), class, facing pages, document body, file, modified, selection, document template, name, password protected
get_all_document_properties.notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-03-23. 'get properties' on the document (not application) works fine. Returns full body text as string — use this to get all content at once. Avoids paragraph iteration.

get_properties_safe.script:
tell application "Pages"
	tell front document
		set docName to name
		set docModified to modified
		return {name:docName, modified:docModified}
	end tell
end tell
get_properties_safe.notes: 'get properties' of application times out. Access individual properties instead.

set_body_text_directly.error: -10006 (Can't set every text of body text)
set_body_text_directly.fix: Use System Events keystroke to type text instead

get_text_of_body_text.error: -1728 (Can't get every text of body text)
get_text_of_body_text.fix: Use 'paragraph N of body text' to get individual paragraphs

word_count_property.fix: Use 'count of words of (paragraph 1 of body text as string)'

save_in_path.error: ETIMEDOUT — script blocks waiting for dialog
save_in_path.fix: Use Cmd+S keyboard shortcut + handle save dialog via System Events

export_string_path.error: Error 6 — document could not be exported
export_string_path.fix: Always use 'POSIX file "/path"' not plain string

get_properties_application.error: ETIMEDOUT — 'tell application Pages to get properties' blocks

get_posix_path_of_file.error: -1728 — Can't get POSIX path of file
get_posix_path_of_file.fix: Use 'file of document' to get file reference but path conversion unreliable

make_paragraph_with_data.fix: Can't make paragraphs via AppleScript. Use keystroke to insert text.

make_table_in_body.error: -2763 Don't know how to create TMAScriptTableInfoProxy
make_table_in_body.fix: Tables cannot be inserted via AppleScript. Use Insert > Table menu via System Events.

set_rtf_export_format.error: Can't make rich text / RTF / «class rtfd» into type constant (-1700 / -2753)
set_rtf_export_format.fix: RTF export not supported via AppleScript 'export' command. Use File > Export To > Rich Text Format… via System Events menu click.

make_document_from_template.error: ETIMEDOUT — make new document with {document template: ...} causes Pages to hang
make_document_from_template.fix: Do NOT use template parameter with make new document. This triggers a contacts permission dialog that blocks. Use plain 'make new document' then apply styling manually.

contacts_permission_dialog.error: ETIMEDOUT — Pages requests Contacts access mid-script, blocking AppleScript
contacts_permission_dialog.fix: Pre-approve or pre-deny contacts access before running mail merge workflows. Use ui_press to click 'Don't Allow' on the dialog before attempting mail merge.

steps: tell application Pages: make new document
Activate Pages, use System Events keystroke to type content
Trigger Cmd+S, handle save dialog via System Events
Set filename in text field 1, navigate to folder with Cmd+Shift+G
Get list: tell application Pages: name of every document
For each doc: export to POSIX file ('/output/' & docName & '.pdf') as PDF
get count of paragraphs of body text of front document
iterate: get paragraph i of body text as string
Concatenate paragraph strings for full text

errors.cause: Pages template chooser or save dialog is blocking the event loop
errors.fix: Dismiss all dialogs before running AppleScript. Use 'make new document' instead of keyboard shortcuts if possible.

errors.cause: Using plain string path instead of POSIX file reference
errors.fix: Always: export to POSIX file "/absolute/path.pdf" as PDF

known_techniques.dismiss_template_chooser: If Pages is freshly launched, click 'New Document' button (AXButton) in the Open dialog, then click 'Create' in the template chooser. Or use AppleScript 'make new document' which bypasses the chooser.
known_techniques.type_text: Pages body text is not directly settable via AppleScript. Use System Events keystroke after activating Pages. Document must have cursor focus.
known_techniques.read_all_paragraphs: Iterate 'repeat with i from 1 to (count of paragraphs of body text)' and collect each paragraph as string.
known_techniques.read_all_text_at_once: FASTER: 'get properties of front document' returns body text as a single string in the 'body text' key. No paragraph iteration needed for full-document text extraction.
known_techniques.word_count: No built-in word count property. Get each paragraph as string, use 'count of words of paraText', sum across all paragraphs.
known_techniques.save_first_time: New documents require a Save As dialog. Trigger Cmd+S, fill text field 1 with filename, use Cmd+Shift+G to navigate to folder, press Return, click Save.
known_techniques.export_formats: Confirmed AS export formats: PDF (as PDF), Word (as Microsoft Word), ePub (as ePub), plain text (as unformatted text), Pages legacy (as Pages 09). ALL require 'POSIX file' keyword. RTF export requires UI: File > Export To > Rich Text Format…
known_techniques.close_without_saving: close document 'Name' saving no — prevents save dialog.
known_techniques.applescript_blocks: Pages AppleScript calls block when any dialog is on screen (template chooser, save dialog, contacts permission). Always ensure no dialogs are showing before running scripts.
known_techniques.track_changes_workflow: 1. Enable: click menu item 'Track Changes' of menu 'Edit'. 2. Type changes. 3. Check count: look for '< > N Changes' in toolbar. 4. Accept/reject: click 'Accept Change' or 'Reject Change' in Edit menu. 5. Disable: click 'Track Changes' again.
known_techniques.hide_competing_apps: Reminders and Code steal focus from Pages. Before automating: tell application System Events to set visible of process 'Reminders' to false; tell process 'Code' to set visible to false. Then activate Pages.
known_techniques.template_listing: tell application Pages to get id of every template — returns all 100+ built-in template IDs.
known_techniques.password_protection_check: tell front document to get password protected — returns boolean. Setting it requires File > Set Password… via menu UI.
known_techniques.find_replace_ui: Cmd+F in Pages opens Spelling & Grammar panel (not a Find bar). The panel has a 'Find & Replace' button that switches to Find & Replace mode. Alternatively use Edit > Find submenu.
known_techniques.contacts_crash_warning: Mail Merge and certain template operations trigger 'Pages would like to access your Contacts' dialog. If this fires mid-script, Pages hangs or crashes. Pre-dismiss by clicking 'Don't Allow' via ui_press before running mail merge workflows.
known_techniques.document_template_id: tell front document to get id of document template — returns the template ID string (e.g. 'Application/Blank/ISO'). Useful for checking document type.
known_techniques.toggle_dark_mode: tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to not dark mode
known_techniques.set_paragraph_style: click button "Body" of splitter group 1 of front window → style picker opens as window → click_text desired style name
known_techniques.insert_table: System Events: click menu item "Basic" of menu 1 of menu item "Table" of menu 1 of menu bar item "Insert" of menu bar 1
known_techniques.export_rtf: System Events: File > Export To > Rich Text Format… → click Save… → navigate path → Return

valueAddFeatures.evidence: 'modified of front document' returns boolean. Poll on interval to detect unsaved changes.

valueAddFeatures.name: Batch DOCX Converter
valueAddFeatures.description: Convert multiple .pages files to .docx for cross-platform sharing
valueAddFeatures.evidence: export to POSIX file as Microsoft Word confirmed working.

valueAddFeatures.name: Smart Search
valueAddFeatures.description: Search across all Pages content with pattern matching
valueAddFeatures.evidence: Content extraction via AppleScript + string matching on paragraph text is confirmed feasible. Edit > Find > Find... (Cmd+F) opens Find & Replace toolbar. AppleScript can read all paragraphs and filter by pattern.

live_validation_results.interference_note: Reminders.app is a login item that repeatedly steals focus. This caused 3 Pages crashes when Contacts permission dialog appeared mid-test. All features involving collaboration (Share, Mail Merge live) were tested via menu inspection only.

template_chooser.evidence: Option+Cmd+N opens template chooser with categories: Basic, Reports, Books, Letters, Curricula Vitae, Flyers & Posters, Newsletters, Stationery, Certificates, Miscellaneous. Cancel and Create buttons present.

word_count_ui.evidence: Cmd+Shift+W toggles word count display at bottom of canvas. Showed 4, 7, 13, 15 words during testing. Menu item: View > Hide/Show Word Count.

find_replace.evidence: Cmd+F opens Find & Replace toolbar with search field and navigation controls. Edit > Find submenu has Find, Find Next, Find Previous, Use Selection for Find, Jump to Selection.

comments.evidence: Shift+Cmd+K inserts a comment bubble with the user's name (Khushi Goyal shown). Comment toolbar button visible. Insert > Comment also works.

track_changes.evidence: Edit > Track Changes toggles on/off. When on: toolbar shows '< > N Changes', Accept/Reject/Paused controls appear. 'Turn Off Tracking' appears in Edit menu when active. Keyboard: Ctrl+Cmd+T.

ruler.evidence: Cmd+R toggles ruler. Ruler visible with tick marks (10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20). View > Show/Hide Ruler menu item present.

export_epub.evidence: AppleScript: export to POSIX file "/tmp/SH_Pages_Test_export.epub" as ePub succeeded with no dialog. File created.

export_plain_text.evidence: AppleScript: export to POSIX file "/tmp/SH_Pages_Test_export.txt" as unformatted text succeeded with no dialog. File created.

export_pdf.evidence: AppleScript: export to POSIX file "/tmp/SH_Pages_Test_final.pdf" as PDF succeeded. File created.

export_word.evidence: AppleScript: export to POSIX file as Microsoft Word confirmed in prior sessions.

full_screen.evidence: Ctrl+Cmd+F enters full screen mode — menu bar hidden, only Pages controls visible. Confirmed via screenshot.

password_protection.evidence: File > Set Password... opens dialog with: Password field, Verify field, Password Hint (recommended), Open with Touch ID toggle, Cancel and Set Password buttons. Confirmed via screenshot.

spell_check.evidence: Edit > Spelling and Grammar > Show Spelling and Grammar opens panel with Change/Ignore/Learn/Define/Guess buttons, language popup, Check grammar checkbox. Tested with misspelled text.

insert_table.evidence: Insert > Table opens table picker with styles: Headers, Basic, Plain, Sums. Table checkbox in toolbar works the same way.

insert_chart.evidence: Insert > Chart opens chart picker with 2D Column, 2D Stacked Column, 2D Bar, 2D Stacked Bar, 2D Line, 2D Area, 2D Stacked Area, 2D Radar, 2D Pie, 2D Donut, 2D Scatter, 2D Bubble, 2D Mixed, 2D 2-Axis, 3D variants, Interactive Column/Bar/Scatter/Bubble.

insert_shape.evidence: Insert > Shape present in menu. Shape checkbox in toolbar confirmed.

insert_footnote.evidence: Insert > Footnote menu item present and executed successfully (no error returned).

insert_bookmark.evidence: Insert > Bookmark present in menu. Keyboard: Option+Cmd+B. Format > Add Link also for hyperlinks.

insert_comment.evidence: Insert > Comment present and functional. Shift+Cmd+K shortcut works.

table_of_contents.evidence: Insert > Table of Contents submenu present. View > Table of Contents panel toggle present.

mail_merge.evidence: File > Mail Merge... present (disabled without merge fields). Insert > Mail Merge Field submenu present. Full workflow UI-only — triggers Contacts permission when activated.

publish_apple_books.evidence: File > Publish to Apple Books present and enabled (enabled=true in AX tree). Requires proper ePub document structure.

template_save.evidence: File > Save as Template... present. 'Create a custom Pages template?' dialog appeared spontaneously with 'Add to Template Chooser' and 'Save...' options.

writing_tools_ai.evidence: Edit > Writing Tools submenu: Show Writing Tools, Proofread, Rewrite, Make Friendly, Make Professional, Make Concise, Summarize, Create Key Points, Make List, Make Table, Compose. Apple Intelligence integration confirmed.

paragraph_styles_inspector.evidence: Inspector panel confirmed with Style tab (font/size/formatting), Layout tab (columns/indents/tabs/borders/background), More tab (pagination/hyphenation). Radio buttons 1/2/3 in AX tree switch between tabs.

page_layout_mode.evidence: File > Convert to Page Layout present (disabled on word-processing doc, enabled on page layout docs). Template chooser offers layout templates.

headers_footers.evidence: Document tab in inspector (View > Inspector > Document Setup) controls headers/footers. Insert > Section menu for section-level header/footer control. AX tree shows AXRadioButton in inspector for Format/Document toggle.

image_gallery.evidence: Insert > Image Gallery present in menu.

image_playground.evidence: Insert > Image Playground... present in menu (Apple Intelligence image generation).

web_video.evidence: Insert > Web Video... present in menu.

record_audio.evidence: Insert > Record Audio present in menu.

collaboration_share.evidence: File > Share... and Activity Settings... present. Share button in toolbar. View > Show Participant Cursors and Show Activity Pane. Note: triggers Contacts permission dialog.

dark_mode.evidence: tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to not dark mode — toggles instantly, confirmed live
dark_mode.note: System-wide toggle, not Pages-specific. Pages respects it automatically.

applescript_set_paragraph_style.method: AX UI — click style button in Format panel
applescript_set_paragraph_style.evidence: click button "Body" of splitter group 1 of front window → style picker opens → click_text on desired style name. Confirmed live: changed Body → Heading (18pt Bold).
applescript_set_paragraph_style.note: Cannot set via AppleScript directly, but AX automation works reliably

applescript_insert_table.evidence: click menu item "Table" of menu 1 of menu bar item "Insert" → click "Basic"/"Headers"/"Plain"/"Sums". Confirmed live.
applescript_insert_table.note: make new table via AS fails (-2763), but menu automation works

export_rtf_applescript.method: System Events File > Export To > Rich Text Format…
export_rtf_applescript.evidence: Menu click → click button "Save…" of sheet → navigate to path → press Return. Confirmed: 19KB .rtf file created at /tmp/pages-rtf-test.rtf
export_rtf_applescript.note: export as rich text via AS fails, but System Events menu automation works

import_word.evidence: File > Open accepts .docx files (open POSIX file). Confirmed via File > Open menu and fact that open command works for any file Pages supports.

sections.evidence: Insert > Section present. AS: count of sections of document = 1 confirmed. body text of section N accessible.

page_breaks.evidence: Insert > Page Break (Cmd+Return), Line Break, Section Break, Column Break all present in Insert menu.

page_number.evidence: Insert > Page Number, Page Count, Date & Time all present in Insert menu.

conditional_highlighting.evidence: Format > Conditional Highlighting... present in menu.

add_link.evidence: Format > Add Link submenu present (Cmd+K). Format > Remove Link also present.
